description: UniFi Poller - Firewall policy posture for UniFi Network zone-based firewall (Prometheus) plus UniFi firewall blocks and threat detections (Loki). Requires UnPoller v2.37.0+; zone panels require v3.0.0+ and an API key; security events require the Loki output and SAVE_SYSLOG.

panels.description: Total firewall policies defined on the selected site(s), predefined and custom. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_total.
panels.title: Total Rules

panels.description: Firewall policies currently enabled. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_enabled.
panels.title: Enabled

panels.description: Firewall policies that exist but are switched off. Highlighted when non-zero so forgotten or temporarily disabled rules stand out. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_disabled.
panels.title: Disabled

panels.description: Policies whose action is BLOCK or REJECT (enabled or not). Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_by_action.
panels.title: Block / Reject Rules

panels.description: Policies you created, as opposed to UniFi's predefined zone policies. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_custom.
panels.title: Custom Rules

panels.description: Policies with syslog logging turned on. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_logging_enabled.
panels.title: Logging Enabled

panels.description: All policies (enabled and disabled) grouped by action. Source: unpoller_firewall_rules_by_action.
panels.title: Rules by Action

panels.description: UniFi-generated zone policies versus policies you created.
panels.title: Predefined vs Custom
Rules Enabled
panels.description: Share of policies that are enabled (enabled / total).

panels.title: Rules by Protocol
panels.description: Policies grouped by protocol, filtered by the Action and Rule selectors. Counted from per-rule series (unpoller_firewall_rule_enabled); UnPoller merges rules that share an identical name, action, protocol, IP version and zones into one series, so this can be slightly lower than Total Rules.

panels.title: Rule Inventory Over Time
panels.description: How the policy set changes over time. Steps in these lines mean someone added, removed, enabled or disabled policies.

panels.title: Changes in Selected Time Range
panels.description: Configuration drift detector for the dashboard's time range. Rule count changes: how often the total number of policies changed. Enable/disable toggles: how often any policy was switched on or off. Priority changes: how often any policy's order changed. Anything above zero that you didn't do yourself deserves a look. Note: adding and removing a policy between two scrapes nets to zero.

panels.title: Firewall Policies
panels.description: Every firewall policy, sorted by priority. Use the column filter icons or the Action / Rule selectors at the top. Zones are shown as UniFi zone IDs: UnPoller's policy metrics carry zone IDs, not zone names. Policies that share an identical name, action, protocol, IP version and zones appear as a single row.

targets.expr: max by (rule_name, action, protocol, ip_version, source_zone, dest_zone, site_name, source) (unpoller_firewall_rule_enabled{source=~"$Controller",site_name=~"$Site",action=~"$Action",rule_name=~"$Rule"})

max by (rule_name, action, protocol, ip_version, source_zone, dest_zone, site_name, source) (unpoller_firewall_rule_index{source=~"$Controller",site_name=~"$Site",action=~"$Action",rule_name=~"$Rule"})

panels.title: Blocked Connections
panels.description: Connections blocked by a firewall policy in the selected time range. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: From the Internet
panels.description: Blocks whose source is a public address, typically scanners and bots probing your public IPs. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` | srcaddr !~ `(10|127)\..*|192\.168\..*|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\..*|f[cd][0-9a-f]{2}:.*|fe80:.*` [$__range]))

panels.title: From Your Network
panels.description: Blocks whose source is a private address inside your network (a device or VLAN hitting a block policy). Worth a look: often a misconfigured device, sometimes a policy that is too strict. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` | srcaddr =~ `(10|127)\..*|192\.168\..*|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\..*|f[cd][0-9a-f]{2}:.*|fe80:.*` [$__range]))

panels.title: Unique Blocked Sources
panels.description: Number of different sources (IPs or devices) that were blocked in the selected time range. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: count(sum by (src) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Blocks Over Time by Policy
panels.description: Blocked connections per time bucket, stacked by the firewall policy that blocked them. Policy names match the Firewall Policies table above. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: sum by (policy) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Top Blocking Policies
panels.description: The firewall policies that blocked the most connections in the selected time range. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

defaults.noValue: No blocks in this time range

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (policy) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top Internet Sources
panels.description: Public IP addresses blocked most often. Repeat offenders are good candidates for a block list. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

defaults.noValue: No internet blocks in this time range

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (src) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` | srcaddr !~ `(10|127)\..*|192\.168\..*|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\..*|f[cd][0-9a-f]{2}:.*|fe80:.*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Your Blocked Devices
panels.description: Devices or private IPs on your network that were blocked most often. UniFi names known clients (name plus the last part of the MAC); unknown ones appear as their IP. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

defaults.noValue: No devices on your network were blocked

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (src) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` | srcaddr =~ `(10|127)\..*|192\.168\..*|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\..*|f[cd][0-9a-f]{2}:.*|fe80:.*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Most Targeted Destinations
panels.description: What the blocked connections were trying to reach: your public IPs for internet traffic, or a device/IP for internal traffic. Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

defaults.noValue: No blocks in this time range

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (dst) (count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent Blocks
panels.description: Every blocked connection, newest first, as UniFi describes it: source, destination and the policy that blocked it. Click a line for all details (MAC, device model, policy ID). Source: UniFi System Log 'Blocked by Firewall' entries, pushed to Loki by UnPoller. UniFi does not include ports or protocol in these entries.

targets.expr: {application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory", policy="parameters.TRIGGER.name", sip="parameters.SRC_IP.name", scl="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.name", sclip="parameters.SRC_CLIENT.ip", dip="parameters.DST_IP.name", ddev="parameters.DST_DEVICE.name" | sub="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | label_format src=`{{ or .scl .sip }}`, srcaddr=`{{ or .sclip .sip }}`, dst=`{{ or .ddev .dip }}` | json msg="message" | line_format `{{.msg}}`

panels.title: Threats Detected
panels.description: Security detections other than firewall blocks in the selected time range. Source: UniFi System Log Security entries other than firewall blocks (e.g. intrusion prevention, honeypot). These only appear if the matching UniFi security features are enabled.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory" | sub!="SECURITY_FIREWALL" [$__range]))

panels.title: High / Very High
panels.description: Threat detections rated HIGH or VERY_HIGH by UniFi. Source: UniFi System Log Security entries other than firewall blocks (e.g. intrusion prevention, honeypot). These only appear if the matching UniFi security features are enabled.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site", severity=~"HIGH|VERY_HIGH"} | json sub="subcategory" | sub!="SECURITY_FIREWALL" [$__range]))

panels.title: Recent Threats
panels.description: Threat detections, newest first, as UniFi describes them. Source: UniFi System Log Security entries other than firewall blocks (e.g. intrusion prevention, honeypot). These only appear if the matching UniFi security features are enabled.

targets.expr: {application="unifi_system_log", category="SECURITY", source=~"$Controller", site_name=~"$Site"} | json sub="subcategory" | sub!="SECURITY_FIREWALL" | json msg="message", title="title_raw" | line_format `[{{.severity}}] {{.title}}: {{.msg}}`

panels.title: Policies Disabled During This Time Range
panels.description: Enabled/disabled history for every policy that was disabled at any point in the selected time range (including policies that are still disabled). Always-on policies are left out to keep this readable, so 'No data' means no policy was disabled in this time range.

targets.expr:
max by (rule_name, action, protocol, source_zone, dest_zone) (unpoller_firewall_rule_enabled{source=~"$Controller",site_name=~"$Site",action=~"$Action",rule_name=~"$Rule"})
  and on (rule_name, action, protocol, source_zone, dest_zone)
(min by (rule_name, action, protocol, source_zone, dest_zone) (min_over_time(unpoller_firewall_rule_enabled{source=~"$Controller",site_name=~"$Site",action=~"$Action",rule_name=~"$Rule"}[$__range] @ end())) == 0)

panels.title: Networks per Firewall Zone
panels.description: Number of networks assigned to each firewall zone. Source: unpoller_firewall_zone_network_count (requires an UnPoller API key).

defaults.noValue: No zone data (requires API key, see panel on the right)

options.content:
### Firewall zones need an UnPoller API key

Zone metrics come from UniFi's Integration API (UniFi Network **9.3.43+**), which UnPoller only calls when it authenticates with an **API key**. This stack authenticates with a username and password, so these panels stay empty until that changes.

In UnPoller, API-key auth **replaces** username/password auth for the controller; it is not an add-on. Review that change before making it.

Zone metrics are labelled with the site's display name (e.g. `Default`) rather than the `Default (default)` form used elsewhere, so they are not filtered by the Site selector.
